description: This file defines the ParentExpression class in the Twig templating engine, representing a parent node in the template's abstract syntax tree used for rendering parent blocks.

classes.name: ParentExpression
classes.description: Represents a parent node in the Twig template syntax, used to output or render parent blocks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ParentExpression with a block name and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the parent expression into PHP code, either yielding or rendering the parent block based on attributes.
